suppress.notes: AndroidX SQLite 2.6.2 is a Java/Kotlin API wrapper. Its AARs contain no SQLite native library; Dependency-Check confuses the AndroidX library version with the unrelated SQLite engine version 2.6.2.
CVE-2026-53914 affects Kotlin build-cache metadata, not kotlin-stdlib at application runtime. Kotlin task caching is disabled in gradle.properties until the fixed Kotlin 2.4.20 has a stable release.
Compose Stability Analyzer Runtime is an Android Compose library, not GitHub Enterprise Server. Dependency-Check mistakes its com.github.skydoves Maven group for the unrelated GitHub product CPE.
